description: Estamos interesados en el desarrollo y la creación de paginas web que ayuden a difundir problematicas sociales, o intereses generales sobre lo que es la NASA
summary: We developed a website were we combine different types of resources to solve the challenge; for example we tried to show some objects that were lost in space. When entering our site you can first see images that catch your eye and by clicking in them you can access to mini games, at the end, they give you the story behind each object. Our goal is to reach all types of audiences and show generations that learning can be interesting.
details: We designed this project to be accesible and interesting for all ages, when you enter our site you can decide wheter to pick the space, moon or mars. By clicking on one of those it displays a variety of objects that were abandoned, we wanted our site to offer an option for every person so we added an option to read the text on the screen out loud if the letter is hard to see for someone. We also included an option where you can have access to NASA actual data, here it has articles or interesting news if there's someone interested in it. We also have a forum part where they can discuss topics related. We look forward to young kids and teenagers realising that study doesn't have to be completely boring but making them see that there are more things to it like this litte minigames, most of the people nowadays don't really read the information completely while investigating something and our site offers a way to get easy information while learning from it art the same time. While creating it we used different types of coding languages; Html, JavaScript, and css, we believe that our project is creative because when you click on the planet the objects appear as if they were orbiting around it, it has also an interesting way of displaying the information and you need to finish the game to get the background of that object wich we believe is something not often seen.
